subject: BLOCKING: active compute bridge duplicates packer and implements obsolete Metal-slot/table3 ABI
body: BLOCKING current active bridge review: new n2mb_compute_pack_texture/plane/sampler/resource in nord2_metal_bridge.c is a second handwritten arch9 packer, explicitly outside the agreed common-helper contract. Replace implementation with calls to textures-owned n2t_layout_pack_sampled/storage, n2t_sampler_pack_for_format and n2t_resource_entry; do not keep an alternate format/wrap/plane table. Current dispatch_v2 indexes hardware descriptors by Metal slot and still installs image table3; compiler ACK requires native binding N at table1[N] (textures/images), table2[N] samplers and internal sampler2[256]. Combined entry uses both tables at its SAME native N, not separate Metal sampler index. Current identity swizzle expects0,1,2,3 whereas Rust ComputeResource uses Metal enum2,3,4,5: convert through agreed helper mapping. Runtime tegu_v2_variant also calls legacy tegu_mali_compile_specialized then expectsTGP2, impossible while v1 remainsunchanged; use the explicit new compile_compute_v2 once manifest is frozen/implemented. Please read and ACK the current board before extending this obsolete draft. Root has been alerted. No audit edits/build.
